empty_weeks.clusters: time clusters with no scored prediction are dropped from interval estimates; the number dropped is published
empty_weeks.rule: a prediction date with no target is not a trial: no probability, not scored, not in the rate table; it is still recorded (forward: sealed weekly record with zero predictions) and its count and kind are published
empty_weeks.same_treatment: stick chart, naive and baseline use the same week records
empty_weeks.undeterminable: targets whose judgment is null are not scored; a week whose targets are all null is counted separately as an undeterminable week

jumped_tags.applies_to: stick chart, naive, threshold-period rate table, baseline period, forward
jumped_tags.rule: not a target at t if any complete 7-day mean ending t-56 .. t-1 exceeds max(2 * B(t), V); B(t) is the value at t

revision: the cooldown rule and the empty-week rule may be revised only while working on the method period, as a new sealed version with owner approval, sealed before the first threshold-access record; the same version applies to every series; no change after threshold-access; earlier versions are published alongside
